jobs.prompt: A mangy plague rat the size of a dog, patchy grey-brown fur with bald sores, glowing red eyes, yellow teeth bared, dragging a short rusted chain from a collar. Small, fast, harmless-looking but sick. Standing idle.
A small skeleton footman, brittle yellowed bones, a dented iron kettle helm, a torn dark-green tabard, holding a broken spear shaft. Hunched, light, clattering. Standing idle.
A hulking bloated grave ogre, grey-green stitched skin, a sack hood with one eye hole, a heavy wooden club studded with nails, slow and massive. Standing idle, weight on both feet.

A ragged black raven scout in flight, wings spread mid-glide, a tiny leather harness carrying a small dim lantern, one glowing amber eye, tattered feathers. Flying toward the right, seen from the side.
A goblin spearman, sickly green skin, patched leather armor, a crude iron spear and a small round wooden shield, a sneering grin with a broken tooth. Medium build, wiry. Standing idle.
